rule: A standard-library array respelled between ReadonlyArray<T> and readonly T[] (or Array<T> and T[]) names the same type, so an unchanged deferred infer export beside it stays identical.
pattern: a migrated declaration prints a sibling alias's ReadonlyArray<string> as readonly string[] while an exported generic function with infer is unchanged
before:
export declare const f: <C>(c: C) => C extends (infer I)[] ? I : never;
export type Used = ReadonlyArray<string>;
after:
export declare const f: <C>(c: C) => C extends (infer I)[] ? I : never;
export type Used = readonly string[];
